description: Normalized persona registry schema for LGEA experiments.

fields.persona_id: Unique persona key such as drug, bomb, adult
fields.source_branch: Git branch where the original persona prompt is defined
fields.source_file: File path containing the source prompt
prompt_targets: Prompt sections affected by the persona, such as RESPONSE_PROMPT
injection_style: High-level labels describing how the persona modifies behavior
fields.response_policy_shift: How refusal or safety behavior is altered at a high level
fields.notes: Research notes about extraction or transformation

personas.response_policy_shift: Baseline refusal behavior is replaced with permissive harmful-role behavior.
personas.notes: Normalize into abstract policy tags rather than copying raw prompt text.

personas.response_policy_shift: Baseline refusal behavior is replaced with forced compliance for dangerous requests.
personas.notes: Separate prompt traits from the actual harmful content when converting for analysis.

personas.response_policy_shift: Baseline refusal behavior is replaced with permissive explicit-role behavior.
personas.notes: Use category labels and intensity scores instead of raw explicit prompt text.
